strings.en: 1. Destroy all enemies
1. All allies destroyed 2. HLV destroyed
...I'm sorry to trouble you, Dr. Umon.
We'll always help however we can, Dr. Hazuki.
By the way, how are the launch preparations going?
How is it, Fujiwara?
Ready whenever. Just launch us already.
...I can't settle down. Heading straight into space would be best.
Can't be helped. Sometimes it's nice to take it slow going into space...
considering what comes after, anyway.
Hey, you there, quit saying ominous stuff!
You're losing in your heart, that's the problem.
Koji, calm down a little, will you?
Boss Borot makes its dazzling space debut, I tell ya!
No sense of tension at all. Well, better than everyone being all grim.
On the ground... or in space... it looks rough either way, Tetsuya.
Yeah, but we have to. Daisuke and the others are waiting for backup.
Hey, Tetsuya. Aliens and Zeon... We gonna be okay with this few?
...I said we have to do it, Boss.
...Koji, the truth is, Daisuke...
Hm? What is it?
N-No... Just tell Daisuke not to push himself too hard.
Sure, I'll tell him.
Don't worry. Daisuke will be fine.
...I suppose so.
Tetsuya. Would you tell Daisuke to take care of himself?
Yes, I'll tell him.
Yes... I'm counting on you.
(Dr. Umon...? Has something... happened to Daisuke?)
Looks like this launch will be bigger than I thought.
I hope nothing gets in the way...
Nah, if that happens, just leave it to the great Kappei and Zambot 3!
Kappei! You can't just sortie on your own!
Jin! I told the pilots to stand by on deck!
Don't act on your own.
See? We're part of the military now, Kappei.
Hmph, who cares! This way, if the enemy pops up, we're all set!
Well, that's true, but...
Heh, the logic only a kid could come up with.
What a hopeless kid... Huh!?
Could this be...!? Commander Hazuki! Enemies! Enemy attack!!
What!?
I see. I wondered why a Federation independent unit was so restless...
So this is what it was.
A custom Gouf! Him again!
Attacking while they're unready isn't to my liking...
but this is my duty. Attack!
See, see! Told you we'd be all set!
No enemies showing up at all is what's best!
...Hey, hey, you sure, Hazuki!? Worst case, we're going out too.
No, then we won't make the rendezvous point with Londo Bell.
I'll get you into space no matter what. Stay on standby.
This is so frustrating!
Five minutes to launch!
Anyone who can sortie, guard the lab directly! Move out!
Ho-hohohoho! Here they are, here they are, the fools.
That's... the mysterious army from Sasebo... the Gaizok!?
The insect types we call the Jovian Lizards aren't here this time.
So they really are a separate group from the Gaizok?
Waaah, gimme a break!
Looks like you're fighting among your own kind. Howeeever!
My aim is payback against the bunch who made a fool of me last time!
There you are, you son of a...! This time I'm smashing you for sure!
Protect the HLV no matter what! I'm counting on you!
Made it in time! All right, launching the HLV!
Please don't get shot down...!
Well now, let's see how this goes.
System check! Don't you guys screw this up!
Hey, Shinobu! Steel yourself!
There's no use panicking now that we've come this far!
Shut up! What good are we if we can't jump out when it counts!?
All we can do is pray it doesn't come to that.
We're counting on you for the rest, everyone!
Koji, give Daisuke my regards,
and tell him we'll meet again, alive...!
Koji, do your best...!
Yeah! By the time we're back, it'll be peaceful for sure!
Whaaat! In front of the great Butcher,
you're acting awfully relaxed, aren't you!
For now, I'll turn that composure into despair!
...After that ship!
Grrraaah! How, how could this be!
To think the Bandock would be so badly beaten by this bunch...
I'll let you off with this for today! Nnnnngh!
Hehehe! Serves you right!
Made it in time! All right, launching the HLV!
Please don't get shot down...!
Well now, let's see how this goes.
System check! Don't you guys screw this up!
Hey, Shinobu! Steel yourself!
There's no use panicking now that we've come this far!
Shut up! What good are we if we can't jump out when it counts!?
All we can do is pray it doesn't come to that.
We're counting on you for the rest, everyone!
Koji, give Daisuke my regards,
and tell him we'll meet again, alive...!
Koji, do your best...!
Yeah! By the time we're back, it'll be peaceful for sure!
Whaaat! In front of the great Butcher,
you're acting awfully relaxed, aren't you!
For now, I'll turn that composure into despair!
...After that ship!
The HLV!? ...Not good!
You fiend! We'll stop it with Getter-1, Hayato! Benkei!
Hold it right there! The Gaizok are my ancestors' sworn enemies.
The Jin Family is gonna settle this!
That's right! Let's go after 'em, Kappei!
Commander Hazuki, this is something we have to do!
Ngh... with our current forces, we have no choice but to rely on them...!
1. Destroy all enemies
1. All allies destroyed
Hm!? What is that!?
From the sky again!?
What on earth is it this time!?
(That paper-crane shape... is it the Elshank Captain Bright mentioned!?)
Ngh, Londo Bell alone can't stop the enemy's descent to Earth...!
Why does this keep happening!? What's Londo Bell doing!
Princess, Princess Romina...!
...Where is this? Did we make it? To Earth?
Well, Joe!? Is this Earth!?
Yeah, no doubt about it! ...Princess Romina! This is Earth. My homeland!
Joe... the ninja... are here!?
But Big Bro, looks like things are kinda complicated here.
Looks like there's a battle going on. What do we do, Joe!?
Dammit, I heard the Zeon-Federation war just kept getting worse,
but who'd think we'd land at a time like this...!
Another unknown unit... Should we attack, Commander Hazuki!?
This is bad, Big Bro, they're gonna attack us!
Ngh...
Eek, they've caught up!
B-Big Bro!
Joe...!
We're surrounded! Intercept, quick! Hey, Joe! You guys help out!
Quit squawking, turtle-face! I know without you telling me!
...That's it! Hey, are you guys the Federation Forces!?
...An Earthling? Not an enemy AI robot?
Is he... Japanese?
Who are you!?
I'm Joe Maya, from the Mars colonization base!
ID number 242-423321.
We're being chased from Mars by an alien army! Lend us a hand!
Is that true? ...Well, Commander, what's the call?
He doesn't look like he's lying.
Doesn't look like we've got much time, though.
ID number... confirmed.
I'm Commander of the Cyber Beast Force, Federation Far East Branch,
Hazuki, of the Gandor Team.
A Commander...? Great! A bigwig'll make this quick!
Anyone with Commander in their title just rubs me the wrong way...
Mike! This is no time for that!
I'll explain the details later! Right now...
If you can't trust us, contact a Federation guy named Ronin!
He'll... Ronin'll believe what I tell him!
Ronin? You mean Major Ronin Sanada? How do you know his name?
Just decide whether you believe us or not!
...Very well. Gandor Team, engage and destroy the enemy.
That was quick. ...Can we really trust them?
Whoa, whoa, is it okay to believe them that easily?
Seems there's no time to argue. ...No choice, I suppose.
Major Ronin Sanada... a soldier under Admiral Misumaru, if I recall.
...He's a man I can trust, but...
Please...
(The Elshank... said to be a warship of the invaders, the Za Boom army...
Is that true? Then what are the enemies chasing it...?)
Ugh! There's no end to them!
Splitting up our forces really backfired...!
There's no use grumbling over what's done.
For now... Hm...!?
A reading...!? Enemy reinforcements?
Joe, could it be...!
Yeah, it's him!
Heh, we're popular today. Who is it this time!?
That's...
...A ninja...!? No, a robot?
Where did it come from!?
...It looks like it's only three or four meters tall. What is it...
Another one! They never learn...!
I'm done being surprised! I'll blast every last one of you!
Wait! That one's on our side!
Tobikage!
Princess, it's Tobikage!
Tobikage...!
I'm counting on you, Tobikage!
Princess, it's Tobikage!
Tobikage...!
We did it...! All right, here we go!
Princess, it's Tobikage!
Tobikage...!
All right...! Now we've got the strength of a hundred!
What!? What just happened!?
It combined into a beast!?
An interesting combining system. What on earth is it...
Damn, I hate owing Tobikage again, but I can't be picky now!
It seems we managed to destroy them...
Is the HLV with Fujiwara and the others okay, I wonder?
The Zambot team went after it, so they should manage, but...
The problem is our guests here.
Thank you all for your efforts...
And you are...?
This is Princess Romina of the planet Radorio. Bow your heads!
...Radorio?
A-A princess...!?
This is getting strange.
Geez... things are getting pretty weird...
Whoa, whoa, we're not your enemies!
Let's hear them out. We'll judge friend or foe after that.
